text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Rice Shower's debut is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Everything starts for real once I go outside.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I didn't think my heart would pound so loudly. Hehehe… I guess I really am scared.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. I can't be scared forever. I have to do my best.
